verdicts.tldr: realm is sealed by a dot-named method user code cannot declare, so no user type reaches PayGas as rlm
verdicts.details: gRealmType's interface carries a `.seal` method (uverse.go:190-195), implemented only on `.grealm` (uverse.go:1807-1810); Gno identifiers cannot start with a dot, so a user struct carrying every exported realm method fails type-check before PayGas runs. The seal predates the PR (present at the merge base), so the IsCurrent/PkgPath trust is sound. Fix: none needed.
verdicts.evidence: judge-13-realm-forgery.txtar at 1f043ddb1: addpkg of a realm passing F{} (IsCurrent true, PkgPath gno.land/r/test/victim) to runtime.PayGas fails: 'gno.land/r/test/forger.F does not implement .uverse.realm (missing method .seal)'; --- PASS: TestTestdata/judge-13-realm-forgery. Base uverse.go also carries .seal (grep count 5).
verdicts.refuted_by: uverse.go:195 Name: ".seal", // a dot-named method that user code cannot declare
verdicts.verify_by: Write a txtar with a realm that declares `type F struct{}` carrying every realm method and calls runtime.PayGas(1000000, F{}) in a 0-fee tx while r/victim is funded; a type-check or runtime rejection closes the candidate.

verdicts.tldr: a sponsored setter that grows in one 0-fee tx and shrinks in the next hands the sponsor's deposit to the signer for free
verdicts.details: sponsorShare = min(depositUnlocked, psi.SpentDeposit) (keeper.go:2547) only nets frees against deposits the sponsor locked in the same tx; in a later tx SpentDeposit is 0, so the whole release goes to receiver = caller. The body's Open item says a deposit refunds whoever frees the bytes, but not that an ordinary overwrite with a smaller value counts as a free, which makes 'nor let callers free what it sponsored' rule out every shrinkable sponsored setter (bio, list, map entry) and lets a signer loop until the sponsor is empty. Not reachable with the window closed; at the merge base PayStorage does not exist, so no deposit is ever paid by anyone but the caller. Fix: refund freed bytes to the sponsor in proportion to the deposit it paid (record the payer per realm deposit), or name shrinking setters in the PayStorage doc and the Open item.

verdicts.tldr: a sponsor-paid storage deposit is reported to the signer as its own storage fee and total tx cost
verdicts.details: lockStorageDeposit debits the sponsor when sponsored, but the event at keeper.go:2488 is StorageDepositEvent{BytesDelta, FeeDelta, PkgPath} (emit_event.go:107-111), with no payer, so keyscli/root.go:78-89 adds FeeDelta into 'TOTAL TX COST' for the signer. Wallets and indexers reading the event charge the signer for a deposit it never paid, and credit it with a sponsorShare refund that went to the sponsor. Only sponsored txs are affected, so a chain that never opts in sees no change. Fix: add a payer field to StorageDepositEvent and StorageUnlockEvent and have gnokey print the deposit only when the payer is the signer.
verdicts.evidence: Same txtar run at 1f043ddb1, tx1 (gas_fee 0ugnot): 'STORAGE DELTA:  2885 bytes' / 'STORAGE FEE:    288500ugnot' / 'TOTAL TX COST:  288500ugnot', then user1 'data: "1000000000ugnot"' and 'cmp stdout user1_balance_before' passes. emit_event.go:107-111 struct has no payer field.

verdicts.tldr: nothing fails if PayGas starts charging the realm on fee-paying txs, the path every chain runs
verdicts.details: The fixture funds the realm 'so a wrong charge would show' (line 11) and then never queries its balance; no Go test sets Eligible false either (the only PayGasInfo literals in tests set Eligible: true, in calibrate benches). With the `|| !pgi.Eligible` gate dropped from X_payGas, settlement debits the realm 1005ugnot on a fee-paying tx and the PR's fixture stays green. The code is correct today; what is lost is the guard on the one path that matters with the feature disabled. Fix: append `gnokey query bank/balances/g1pkhf78w28n9m9cgm4nsn3q3cggjy39nu7m3z0f` and `stdout '"10000000ugnot"'` after line 18.
